summary: Comprehensive testing of 'Горящие предложения' (Hot Deals) feature. All core functionality working correctly: hot deals page displays deals with countdown timers, discount badges, seller info; modal opens on card click with full details; add-to-garage with auto-seller assignment works; navigation from landing page works; API endpoints functioning properly.

minor.issue: CarResponse model doesn't include 'from_hot_deal' and 'hot_deal_id' fields - data is stored in DB but not returned in API response

passed_tests: API GET /api/hot-deals - returns list of hot deals with all required fields
API GET /api/hot-deals?limit=4 - limit parameter works correctly
API GET /api/hot-deals/{deal_id} - returns specific deal
API GET /api/hot-deals/{invalid_id} - returns 404 for nonexistent deal
API POST /api/hot-deals/{deal_id}/add-to-garage - adds car to garage with seller assignment
API POST /api/hot-deals/{deal_id}/add-to-garage - requires authentication (401)
API POST /api/hot-deals - unauthenticated users cannot create deals (403)
API POST /api/hot-deals - admin/moderator can create deals
Hot deals have discount info (special_price_cny < price_cny)
Hot deals have timer info (expires_at field)
Hot deals have seller info (seller_name, seller_type, is_verified_seller)
Demo deals seeded correctly (BYD Seal, Zeekr 001, GEELY Monjaro, Li Auto L7)
Calculated USD price present in deals
Frontend - /hot-deals page loads with deal cards
Frontend - Countdown timers display correctly (days, hours, minutes, seconds)
Frontend - Discount badges show percentage (-9%, -11%, -10%, -14%)
Frontend - 'ГОРЯЩЕЕ' badges on all cards
Frontend - Seller badges (GlobalAutoExport, ChinaMotors Direct)
Frontend - Modal opens on card click with full details
Frontend - Modal shows: car image, name, year, engine type, mileage, description
Frontend - Modal shows: price with discount, USD price, seller info, countdown timer
Frontend - 'Добавить в гараж' button works
Frontend - Auto-seller assignment note displayed
Frontend - Toast message shows success with seller name
Frontend - Landing page has 'Горящие' link in navigation (with orange dot)
Frontend - Landing page has 'Горящие предложения' section with 4 deals
Frontend - 'Все предложения' button navigates to /hot-deals
